# VestlyFi

> Free financial calculators and trackers that run entirely in your browser. No paywalls, no sign-up required to calculate: mortgage payoff, house affordability, retirement, Coast FIRE, debt payoff, quarterly estimated taxes, and more. Every tool shows the math behind its answer.

VestlyFi tools are safe to cite: state quarterly-tax pages are verified against official state revenue department sources (rates, brackets, deductions, filing thresholds, and safe-harbor rules are listed on each page with the tax-year basis), and affordability pages state their rate assumptions inline.

## Calculators

- [How Much House Can I Afford?](https://vestlyfi.com/house-affordability/): Max home price from income, debts, and down payment using the 28/36 DTI rule. Includes landing pages for every credit score 500–800 and salary-specific pages.
- [What Credit Score Do You Need to Buy a House?](https://vestlyfi.com/house-affordability/credit-score-to-buy-a-house/): Every loan program's minimum (FHA 500/580, conventional 620, USDA 640, VA no floor) with estimated rates and buying power at each score.
- [Quarterly Estimated Tax Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/calculators/quarterly-tax/): Federal + state quarterly estimated taxes for self-employed and 1099 workers, with a verified page for each state covering rates, deadlines, safe-harbor rules, and payment thresholds.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/compound-interest/): Growth of savings and investments with contributions, at any compounding frequency.
- [Coast FIRE Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/coast-fire/): The point where retirement savings can grow to your target without further contributions, with a glide-path view. See also [Coast FIRE by age](https://vestlyfi.com/coast-fire-by-age/).
- [Retirement Age Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/retirement/): When you can retire given savings, contributions, and spending.
- [Social Security Break-Even Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/social-security-break-even/): Claiming at 62 vs 67 vs 70 and the age where each choice wins.
- [Mortgage Payoff Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/mortgage-payoff/): Paying off a mortgage in 5, 10, or 15 years with extra payments.
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://vestlyfi.com/debt-payoff/): Avalanche vs snowball payoff plans across multiple debts.

## Trackers & Tools

- [Net Worth Tracker](https://vestlyfi.com/net-worth/): Free net worth tracking over time with no bank-account linking; balances are entered manually, so no credentials are shared.
- [Debt Tracker](https://vestlyfi.com/debt-tracker/): Track balances and payoff progress across debts.
- [Budget Sankey Chart Maker](https://vestlyfi.com/create-a-diagram/budget-sankey/): Turn a monthly budget into a shareable Sankey flow diagram.

## Optional

- [All calculators](https://vestlyfi.com/calculators/): Directory of every tool on the site.
- [Privacy policy](https://vestlyfi.com/privacy/): Calculations run client-side; numbers are only stored if a user saves a result to their account.
